name: Lyrion Server
summary: Your own music library on the player itself, from its Music folder, a USB drive or a network share.

settings.label: Library
settings.note: What Lyrion is doing with your music, and what it holds.

settings.label: More for your library
settings.note: Everything else about the library is on the Lyrion server's own page. Lyrion can also be controlled from an app.

settings.label: Music folder
settings.note: The player's own Music folder, shared on your network as Music. Switching it off later makes Lyrion rescan your whole library.

settings.label: USB drives
settings.note: Folders on USB drives plugged into the player. Switching it off later makes Lyrion rescan your whole library.

settings.label: USB folders
settings.note: What Lyrion reads from each USB drive: the whole drive or folders you choose. Removing one later makes Lyrion rescan your whole library.
settings.empty: No USB drive plugged in. Plug one into the player, then choose its folders here.

settings.label: Network shares
settings.hint: Not in the list? Some servers do not announce themselves - add the share by its address.
settings.note: Music folders on a NAS or a computer, mounted read-only and offered to the server.
settings.empty: No shares found or added. A share that does not announce itself can be added by its address.

removes: Its library, its settings, the add-ons it installed and the network shares with their logins are deleted too. The Music folder and its playlists stay. Switching it on again downloads it and starts a new library.
